item.content:encoded:
Opposition MP Premila Kumar also raised concerns about Fiji’s limited fiscal space for borrowing, as the country prepares for El Niño and the cyclone season, and has questioned what measures are in place to reduce Government expenditure.

While responding, Immanuel says the Government has already introduced cost-cutting measures and expenditure rationalisation, with adjustments made since February to address the global fuel crisis.

He says the current financial year’s budget has already accounted for the crisis , and the Government must continue its capital expenditure programme while supporting vulnerable people.

Immanuel says there is limited room to make further changes this financial year, given the global economic situation.

item.title: Seru surprised by Best Hat wins with sister’s last-minute creation
item.description: A tropical-inspired hat put together at the last minute by her florist sister has earned 57-year-old Kini Seru from Suva recognition at the Melbourne Cup and Calcutta Cup celebrations. Seru won the Best Hat award at the Fiji Fashion Week Melbourne and the Calcutta Cup at Art Wine Bar & Restaurant.
item.content:encoded:
A tropical-inspired hat put together at the last minute by her florist sister has earned 57-year-old Kini Seru from Suva recognition at the Melbourne Cup and Calcutta Cup celebrations.

Seru won the Best Hat award at the Fiji Fashion Week Melbourne and the Calcutta Cup at Art Wine Bar & Restaurant.

She says the hat was prepared by her sister, Marica, of Garden of Eden, earlier that morning.

Seru says she was unsure what to expect when her sister asked about the theme, but simply requested something tropical.

She says the beautiful sunny weather in Suva inspired the idea, as the city does not always get such sunshine.

Seru says she never expected to win and is excited and grateful for the recognition.
